people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
translations.bsb: At the end of nine months and twenty days, having gone through the whole land, they returned to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
translations.asv: So when they had gone to and from through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
